title: Hướng dẫn và đánh giá tiện ích: Braille Essentials (Bản 26.10.1)
summary: Thông tin chi tiết về tiện ích Braille Essentials trên NVDA: tính năng thực tế, mức độ hỗ trợ tiếng Việt, phím tắt thao tác và cách cài đặt an toàn.
author: Võ Duy Khánh & Cộng đồng NVDA

sections.heading: 1. Thông tin tiện ích
sections.content:
Tiện ích do tác giả **josephsl** phát triển theo giấy phép **GPL v2**.

This add-on provides essential features for NVDA users relying on braille support. The following features, deriving from Braille Extender, are available:

* Reload two favorite braille display with shortcuts.
* Automatic review cursor tethering in terminal role like in PuTTY, Powershell, bash, cmd.
* Auto scroll.
* Switch between several input/output braille tables.
* Mark the text with special attributes through dot 7, dot 8 or both.
* Use two output braille tables simultaneously.
* Display tab signs as spaces.
* Reverse forward scroll and back scroll buttons.
* Say the current line during text scrolling either in review mode, or in focus mode or both.
* Translate text easily in Unicode braille and vice versa. E.g.: z <--> ⠵.
* Convert cell description to Unicode braille and vice versa. E.g.: 123 <--> ⠇.
* Lock braille keyboard.
* Launch an application/URL with gesture.
* Braille dictionaries.
* Type with one-hand from braille keyboard.
* Display undefined characters from braille tables (including emojis) using altenative representations.
* Enter any character from braille keyboard (including emojis).
* Skip blank lines during text scrolling.
* Speech History Mode.

And much more.

For some braille displays, it extends the braille display commands to provide:

* Offer complete gesture maps including function keys, multimedia keys, quick navigation, etc.
* Emulate modifier keys, and thus any keyboard shortcut
* Offer several keyboard configurations concerning the possibility to input dots 7 and 8, enter and backspace
* Add actions and quick navigation through a rotor

Cách phân phối: Tiện ích đã được duyệt vào Cửa hàng Add-on Store chính thức của NVDA. Bạn có thể mở menu NVDA để cài đặt trực tiếp, hoặc tải tệp tại trang này.

sections.heading: 2. Khả năng đọc tiếng Việt
sections.content: Tác giả chưa tích hợp tiếng Việt nên các tùy chọn hiển thị bằng tiếng Anh. Tuy nhiên cách bố trí phím bấm tuân theo chuẩn NVDA thông thường, giọng đọc tiếng Việt vẫn đọc được các mục bình thường.

sections.heading: 1. Thông tin tiện ích
sections.content:
Tiện ích do tác giả **Hassan Al-Barshoumy** phát triển theo giấy phép **GPL v2**.

Revolutionize your screen reading experience with Advanced Audio Themes, the ultimate auditory powerhouse for NVDA.

Immerse yourself in a dynamic 3D soundscape where every UI event—from navigating menus to tracking progress bars and typing—is brought to life with rich, customizable spatial audio. With the built-in Audio Themes Studio, you can effortlessly craft, edit, and explore a cloud-based library of community-driven themes.

Empower your workflow with groundbreaking features:
- Studio-Grade Audio DSP: Elevate your audio with real-time Bass Boost, Noise Gate, and intelligent Audio Ducking.
- System Status Sounds: Stay seamlessly connected to your PC with instant, native audio alerts for battery, USB, power, and network events.
- Smart App Profiles: Enjoy a tailored experience as themes and typing soundscapes adapt automatically to your active application.
- 3D Sonar & Beacons: Visualize your screen spatially by dropping audio beacons and sweeping windows with radar-like precision.
- Lightning-Fast Navigation: Break free from complex keystrokes using the modifier-free Navigation Layer, alongside deeply integrated BrowserNav and SentenceNav engines.
- Phonetic Punctuation: Take total control over speech feedback with pinpoint rules for words, states, and roles.

Step beyond traditional screen reading and unleash a breathtaking auditory dimension to your daily tasks!

sections.heading: 1. Thông tin tiện ích

sections.heading: 1. Thông tin tiện ích
sections.content:
Tiện ích do tác giả **Çağrı Doğan <cagrid@hotmail.com>** phát triển theo giấy phép **GPL v2**.

freeAudio is an internet radio, podcast, audio-book, and local music add-on for NVDA that provides seamless access to thousands of internet radio stations via the Radio Browser open directory, RSS/Atom podcast feeds, the libriVox + GETEM digital library for the visually impaired, and your own local audio files and folders through its built-in jukebox. It features a fully accessible station browser with search, country filter, favourites management, and per-station, per-podcast, per-audio-book, and per-jukebox-track audio profiles. Podcast episodes, audio book chapters, and jukebox tracks resume automatically from where you left off - jukebox folders even pick up on the last track you were playing - with adjustable pitch-preserving playback speed and independent pitch-shift (semitone transpose). Playback is handled by BASS, with support for volume control, audio effects, output device selection, and simultaneous audio mirroring to a second device. Additional features include instant and scheduled recording, time-shift rewind of live radio, sleep and alarm timers, automatic ICY metadata announcements, Shazam-based music recognition, and a liked-songs log with lyrics lookup. All controls and shortcuts are designed for NVDA accessibility.

NVDA+Alt+W: describe the current window
NVDA+Alt+F: describe the whole screen

author: Võ Duy Khánh & Cộng đồng NVDA

sections.heading: 1. Thông tin tiện ích
sections.content:
Tiện ích do tác giả **Ramesh Patil** phát triển theo giấy phép **GPL v2**.

Telephone Operator helps users make phone calls without manually typing phone numbers on their phone. Select or focus a phone number on the computer and use the NVDA shortcut to send the number to a phone connected to the same network. Verify the number on the phone and press CALL.

To start: Press NVDA+Alt+Z or Go to NVDA menu > Tools > Telephone Operator > Start Telephone Operator.
On your phone: Open the displayed address in your browser or scan the QR code shown in the dialog.
To send a number: Press NVDA+Alt+C after selecting or focusing the phone number.
The number will appear on your Phone. Verify number and Press Call button.
To stop: Press NVDA+Alt+Z or Go to NVDA menu > Tools > Telephone Operator > Stop Telephone Operator.

sections.heading: 1. Thông tin tiện ích
sections.content:
Tiện ích do tác giả **Meseret Worku Alemu** phát triển theo giấy phép **GPL v2**.

A rich Ethiopian calendar and Bahre Hasab add-on for NVDA. It reports the current Ethiopian date, the full Bahre Hasab (Amete Alem, Wengelawi, Metqe, Abekte, Mebaja Hamer, Tewsak and more), movable feasts and fasts, fasting and liturgical seasons, Great Lent weekly names, lunar age, moon phase, and zodiac. It also offers the daily Gitsawe — the three church services (Morning, Eucharist, Evening) — with the full Bible passage inlined for every citation, plus the Synaxarium of saints for any Ethiopian date, national FDRE holidays, an Islamic (Hijri) calendar, and a Hebrew calendar. Additional tools include an exact Ethiopian age calculator, a planning workspace with agenda and export to CSV, JSON, Markdown, HTML and iCal, a menstrual cycle tracker with ovulation and fertile window prediction, a pregnancy due date calculator, and Ethiopian local and Bahre Hasab 'kekros' times. Every result is rendered as a fully navigable HTML page with headings, lists and tables, so NVDA users can jump around quickly with H, T and L. Amharic and English supported.

summary: Thông tin chi tiết về tiện ích freeRadio: Radio and more trên NVDA: tính năng thực tế, mức độ hỗ trợ tiếng Việt, phím tắt thao tác và cách cài đặt an toàn.
author: Võ Duy Khánh & Cộng đồng NVDA

sections.heading: 1. Thông tin tiện ích
sections.content:
Tiện ích do tác giả **Çağrı Doğan <cagrid@hotmail.com>** phát triển theo giấy phép **GPL v2**.

FreeRadio is an internet radio, podcast, audio-book, and local music add-on for NVDA that provides seamless access to thousands of internet radio stations via the Radio Browser open directory, RSS/Atom podcast feeds, the libriVox + GETEM digital library for the visually impaired, and your own local audio files and folders through its built-in jukebox. It features a fully accessible station browser with search, country filter, favourites management, and per-station, per-podcast, per-audio-book, and per-jukebox-track audio profiles. Podcast episodes, audio book chapters, and jukebox tracks resume automatically from where you left off - jukebox folders even pick up on the last track you were playing - with adjustable pitch-preserving playback speed and independent pitch-shift (semitone transpose). Playback is handled by BASS, with support for volume control, audio effects, output device selection, and simultaneous audio mirroring to a second device. Additional features include instant and scheduled recording, time-shift rewind of live radio, sleep and alarm timers, automatic ICY metadata announcements, Shazam-based music recognition, and a liked-songs log with lyrics lookup. All controls and shortcuts are designed for NVDA accessibility.

YouTube Access Pro คือโปรแกรมเสริมสำหรับ NVDA ที่ให้เข้าถึง YouTube ได้อย่างเต็มรูปแบบด้วยแป้นพิมพ์เพียงอย่างเดียว ค้นหาหรือวางลิงก์เพื่อเล่นและดาวน์โหลดวิดีโอ เพลย์ลิสต์ หรือช่องได้โดยตรง พร้อมคีย์ลัดควบคุมการเล่นครบครัน (เล่น/หยุด กรอ ปรับเสียง ปรับความเร็ว เล่นต่อเนื่องอัตโนมัติ) และตัวจับเวลาปิดในตัว

ใหม่! โหมดคาราโอเกะ: ตัดเสียงร้องขณะเล่น (Shift+F8) หรือดาวน์โหลดเป็น MP3 คาราโอเกะ (Shift+F1)

จัดการเพลย์ลิสต์ส่วนตัวได้อิสระ และติดตามช่องที่ชื่นชอบผ่านแท็บ Subscriptions ซึ่งไล่ดูเนื้อหาได้เหมือน YouTube เอง แบ่งเป็นหมวด Videos, Shorts, Live และ Playlists ดาวน์โหลดเป็นไฟล์ MP3, MP4 หรือ คาราโอเกะ MP3 ได้ทันทีพร้อมเลือกคุณภาพ และจัดเก็บเป็นหมวดหมู่ตามเพลย์ลิสต์หรือช่องให้อัตโนมัติ

ใช้งานได้ทั้งภาษาไทยและอังกฤษ สลับได้ทันทีด้วย Ctrl+T เรียกหน้าต่างขึ้นมาจากทุกที่ด้วย NVDA+Y และฟังสรุปคีย์ลัดของแต่ละหน้าได้ทันทีด้วย Ctrl+F1 คู่มือฉบับเต็มพร้อมรายละเอียดคีย์ลัดทั้งหมดแนบมากับโปรแกรมเสริมนี้

YouTube Access Pro is an NVDA add-on that provides full keyboard-only access to YouTube. Search or paste a link to play and download videos, playlists, or channels directly, with complete playback shortcuts (play/pause, seek, volume, speed, automatic continuous playback) and a built-in sleep timer.

NEW! Karaoke Mode: vocal-cut playback (Shift+F8) or karaoke MP3 download (Shift+F1)

Manage personal playlists freely, and follow favorite channels through the Subscriptions tab, browsing content the way YouTube itself organizes it - Videos, Shorts, Live, and Playlists. Download instantly as standard MP3, MP4, or Karaoke MP3 with selectable quality, automatically sorted into folders by playlist or channel.

Available in both Thai and English, switch instantly with Ctrl+T. Open the window from anywhere with NVDA+Y, and hear a shortcut summary for the current tab anytime with Ctrl+F1. A full user guide with complete shortcut details is included with this add-on.


Cách phân phối: Tiện ích đã được duyệt vào Cửa hàng Add-on Store chính thức của NVDA. Bạn có thể mở menu NVDA để cài đặt trực tiếp, hoặc tải tệp tại trang này.

Whether you are drafting documents, composing messages, working with audio recordings, or communicating across languages, AI voice dictation is your voice-powered productivity companion, made and maintained in Nepal.
